additional_info.subject: ID0456349-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002653] Modbus port 400 closed CRM:03056000229
additional_info.body:
Hi Valerio,
I'm not sure what software they use and how, but on our side we use MBPoll and use the following command:
mbpoll -m tcp -p 400 -0 -r 0 -c 26 10.20.17.10
Maybe you can try installing this software and retry, from our side, everything is working accordingly and I don't see what we can do more.
ELMS is purely based on the IP address that you give us and if we can ping their network that means that they are reachable.
I've had this problem once with another customer where the controller couldn't accept the Port 400 and had to be 502, since these two numbers are declared as default for modbus.
I will wait for your feedback.
Best regards,
Francisco
